design.affected_system: walking, cycling, and shared micromobility network
alternatives: screen feasible locations against the largest access gaps for shared-mobility station and secure-parking locations
co-optimize distributed and high-capacity locations for shared-mobility station and secure-parking locations
pair demand-, access-, and right-of-way-constrained facility siting with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Trips, counts, facilities, stress levels, barriers, and shared-vehicle states use documented coverage.
Observed shared-system trips do not represent all walking and cycling demand.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
design.baseline: retain only existing approved locations for shared-mobility station and secure-parking locations.

constraints.description: The active mobility network and micromobility site must respect declared land control, accessibility, permitting, safety, and operating feasibility.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

design.decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
design.decision_owner: active transportation director and shared-mobility program manager
design.decision_question: Where should stations and secure parking expand access without obstructing pedestrian use?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The active mobility network and micromobility site must respect declared land control, accessibility, permitting, safety, and operating feasibility.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for shared-mobility station and secure-parking locations passes documented checks for parcel control, legal authority, environmental review, access, capacity, and operator responsibility.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: demand-, access-, and right-of-way-constrained facility siting

design.intended_claim: A versioned site design for comparing declared alternatives affecting shared-mobility station and secure-parking locations, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: distributional gap in residents beyond reliable shared-mobility access
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not label a candidate station feasible, accessible, or publicly accepted without validation.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for shared-mobility station and secure-parking locations passes documented checks for parcel control, legal authority, environmental review, access, capacity, and operator responsibility.

design.title: Site shared-mobility stations and secure parking
transportability_risks: Topography, climate, street stress, vehicle access, pricing, and safety perceptions vary.
Platform data can exclude private bicycles, pedestrians, and non-users.

family.affected_system: walking, cycling, and shared micromobility network
